title: Platinum Reserve Account: Daily Interest Compounding Explained
summary: Explains how the Platinum Reserve Account’s daily interest compounding works: a daily periodic rate derived from 5.0% is applied to end-of-day ledger balances, with earned interest added to principal each day. Covers effects of earlier deposits and intra-day withdrawals, interaction with the $50.00 monthly maintenance fee, plus verification via end-of-day balance comparisons and period-end statements.
faqs: How is the daily periodic rate derived from the 5.0% interest rate applied?
